name: tcg-price-japan
description: Read-only Japan TCG (Pokemon/TCG) used-price trend data from suruga-ya.jp. Three tools: current price, price history, and top movers. No account, no API key, no network.
long_description: Exposes the accumulated kensho Japan TCG used-price dataset (960 observations from suruga-ya.jp, 2026-09-21 snapshot) as three read-only MCP tools: tcg_current_price (latest used/new/list price in JPY), tcg_price_history (time series), and tcg_top_movers (biggest |delta JPY| movers with optional up/down filter). Pure local data, zero dependencies beyond fastmcp. Ideal for AI agents researching Japanese collectibles market trends.

tools.name: tcg_current_price
tools.description: Latest used/new/list price snapshot (JPY) for a Pokemon/TCG item in the Japan Suruga-ya dataset.

tools.name: tcg_price_history
tools.description: Price time series (oldest first) for an item, up to limit rows.

tools.name: tcg_top_movers
tools.description: Biggest |delta JPY| movers in the dataset, with optional up/down direction filter.
